purpose: Teach: トースト/キャンドル/めんどくさい/しわ/拾う/ガラガラ/バンバン/ローマ字

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、トースト、絶対、サンドイッチ、絶対、作ってあげるね
lines.en: Sho, I'm serious — I'm going to make you toast and sandwiches, no matter what.
lines.style: Warm, present attention. Soft opening, like she's making a small promise. Even rhythm. The kind of gentle certainty a older sister offers a younger brother.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、キャンドル、絶対、お祖父ちゃんに、絶対、プレゼント、絶対、したいんだ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'm serious — I really want to give Grandpa a candle as a present.
lines.style: Eager but sincere, no performance. Quick intake of breath at the start. Slight lean forward. The unselfconscious certainty of a six-year-old who has decided something matters.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 毎日のお片付け、本気で、絶対、めんどくさい、絶対、けど、絶対、習慣になれば、絶対、楽よ、翔くん
lines.en: Picking up after yourself every day is annoying, I know — but once it becomes a habit, it gets easier, Sho.
lines.style: Practical warmth. Light touch on the difficulty, then settles into steady encouragement. Patient pacing, like she's spoken these words before and means them each time.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、お顔に、絶対、しわ、絶対、まだ、絶対、ないよね
lines.en: Mei-sis, you don't have any wrinkles on your face yet, right?
lines.style: Bright, observant wonder. Genuine curiosity without guile. Quick pace, the way a six-year-old asks things that catch adults off-guard. Slight head tilt in the voice.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 公園で、本気で、絶対、ゴミ、絶対、拾うこと、絶対、二人で、絶対、しましょうね、翔くん
lines.en: Let's pick up trash together at the park, okay Sho? I'm serious about this.
lines.style: Tender but matter-of-fact. Not performing kindness — just quietly including him. Steady, unhurried. The slight emphasis on 'together' carries all the reassurance.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、駄菓子屋の、絶対、ガラガラ、絶対、ぼく、絶対、引きたいんだ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I really want to pull the raffle at the candy store.
lines.style: Unburdened eagerness. Small bright voice. No hesitation, no performance. The immediate want of a six-year-old. Quick tempo on the setup, slight elongation on 'pull' — the imagined action itself.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 打ち上げ花火、本気で、絶対、バンバン、絶対、上がっていたわよね、翔くん
lines.en: The fireworks were really going off, weren't they — boom after boom, Sho.
lines.style: Animated recollection. Slight rise on 'boom boom' like she's painting the memory back into the room. Conversational, nostalgic. The tone of someone sharing something bright with someone she cares about.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、ローマ字、絶対、書けるようになったんだ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I learned how to write in Romaji!
lines.style: Quiet pride. Slight brightness at the start. The voice of a six-year-old who has mastered something and is waiting for the person he trusts to notice. Slight lift at the end — not asking for confirmation, offering the accomplishment.
